description: SousAI helps users save, find, view, and update their private recipes, manage grocery lists, and track kitchen inventory from ChatGPT. All tools operate only on the authenticated user's SousAI account. Use it to save a recipe, locate a saved recipe, update recipe details, check a grocery list or pantry, and add items to either list.

defaultPrompt: Find my saved vegetarian pasta recipes and show me the full recipe
Check my grocery list and kitchen inventory, then add ingredients I need for tonight’s dinner
